column1: # Readable Spanish (es-MX) for Latin -> Spanish (la2x, task C11). Our own table; tab-separated; '#' comments.
# Same columns and kinds as readable_en.tsv. es-MX choices: tú / ustedes (never vosotros, never usted for tú),
# "ustedes" verbs in the 3rd plural, possessive of vester = su(s), "en la mañana", "recámara", clitic pronouns before
# the finite verb and attached to affirmative imperatives and infinitives. Determiner rows carry gender.number
# (m.sg f.sg m.pl f.pl); lex rows: note "estar" = the adjective takes estar as a predicate.
# ---- names (Latin name key -> Spanish); others: -us -> -o, initial I + vowel -> J ----
# ---- C11b: homographs (lexh, see readable_en.tsv) and deponents ----
